extension.summary: Movies and series for Lucent, with AIOStreams and Trakt
Films en series voor Lucent, met AIOStreams en Trakt
extension.description: Browse with TMDB, play through your own AIOStreams address and keep your progress on Trakt. Works without Seren.
Bladeren met TMDB, afspelen via je eigen AIOStreams-adres en je voortgang bijhouden op Trakt. Werkt zonder Seren.
extension.news: 0.20.0: What shall we watch? Tick who watches and what you feel like, and get three titles none of you saw yet. Your year of watching: hours, films, episodes, most watched series and favourite kinds. Previous time: the resume window tells what happened in the episode before. 0.19.0: Ready in top quality: a message when a film on your watchlist or a new episode can be played in the quality you want (off by default). Sources that keep failing on this device move down, ones that play well move up. Watch together: tick who watches along and it is marked as watched for them too. Offer to open your own subscription app (Android). Subtitles in your language checked beforehand with Lucent Subtitles. 0.18.0: Streaming services: a row with your services and six lists per service (new, popular and top rated movies and series). 0.17.1: New list: New series (started in the last four months). Without a key the main menu shows the setup assistant, and Settings and help always opens. 0.17.0: Coming soon for movies and series shows only what is still to come, nearest date first; the calendar shows episodes from today up to two months ahead. Library titles get every TMDB poster, logo and background (Choose art), and Lucent Video options in their context menu. New, tidier main menu and settings.
